name: market-watch
description: Real-time market watch: React + Vite front end, NestJS WebSocket back end

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @market/server" "npm run dev -w @market/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @market/server && npm run build -w @market/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @market/server && npm run test -w @market/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @market/server && npm run typecheck -w @market/web && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json
